source_sha_role: validated 52-item social-impact source head before release receipt commit
source_sha_policy: Cloudflare Pages builds the governed dist artifact from main; production acceptance requires live domain, route, API and visual verification.

data_contract.policy: Evidence before amplification; every metric requires a dated snapshot; duplicate URLs collapse at runtime; private, minor, legal, financial and quarantined records are excluded from the public universe.

social_corpus.default_projection: non-archive public-life records; civic/political records remain available as neutral public archive
social_corpus.policy: Person before platform; source-linked public material; public comments are short, source-verifiable and name-suppressed in projection; mixed response is preserved; metrics require a dated source.

release_intent: Present Igor Vepretski as a living public record with a 52-item cross-platform corpus, source-linked Facebook and Instagram impact, verified public audience response, original media, long-form audio, StartOn, research and music; political/civic records remain neutral archival records rather than ranked recommendations.
promotion_gate: Promote to READY after 7ya.io serves v8, the homepage exposes the impact wall and audience voices, the client feed loads 52 corpus items, and critical routes pass live verification.
rollback: Prior Git commits and the last valid AppDeploy version remain available as rollback references; production routing must not use an AppDeploy catch-all proxy.
remaining_gates: GitHub Actions is currently blocked before job start by an account billing lock; resolve GitHub billing to restore the governed deployment workflow.
Verify v8 on 7ya.io and 7ya-io.pages.dev after deployment, including 52-item feed, audience voices, /media/ social-impact section, and apex/www routing.
